# FitMe Pro

> Free health and fitness calculators for body composition, weight, calories, nutrition, running, strength, and heart-rate metrics.

## Calculators and guides

- [All calculators](https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/calculators) — Browse the site's 100 free health and fitness calculators by topic.
- [Body Composition](https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/calculator-category/body-composition) — Calculators for BMI, body fat, lean mass, body density, and waist-based indices.
- [Weight Management](https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/calculator-category/weight-management) — Calculators for healthy weight, target weight, weight change, weight-loss timelines, and calorie planning.
- [Calories & Metabolism](https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/calculator-category/calories) — Calculators for BMR, TDEE, maintenance calories, calorie deficits, surpluses, and exercise energy.
- [Nutrition & Macros](https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/calculator-category/nutrition) — Calculators for protein, carbohydrates, fats, fibre, water, sodium, caffeine, and macronutrients.
- [Running & Endurance](https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/calculator-category/running) — Calculators for running pace, speed, race times, splits, training zones, and aerobic fitness.
- [Strength & Gym](https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/calculator-category/strength) — Calculators for one-rep max, rep max, training volume, and strength-to-weight metrics.
- [Heart Rate & Cardiovascular](https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/calculator-category/heart) — Calculators for heart-rate estimates, training zones, recovery, blood-pressure metrics, and cardiovascular fitness.
- [FitMe Pro Journal](https://fitme-pro.vercel.app/journal) — Evidence-informed guides with definitions, measurement advice, practical context, and common questions.
